Heavy-Duty Compact Tractor Performance

Built for Productivity. Engineered for Comfort.

The KIOTI NS4710HCB combines diesel performance, hydrostatic ease of operation, and enclosed cab comfort into a versatile compact tractor platform. Designed for loader work, mowing, grading, material handling, and property maintenance, it delivers excellent lifting capability, hydraulic performance, and operator convenience.

Features May Include:

Factory Enclosed Cab with Heat & A/C

Climate-controlled cab improves operator comfort during hot summers, cold weather, dust, and rain.

KIOTI 45 HP Diesel Engine

Turbocharged diesel engine provides dependable torque, fuel efficiency, and strong pulling performance for demanding applications.

Hydrostatic Transmission (HST)

Three-range hydrostatic transmission allows smooth, clutch-free operation and precise speed control.

Four-Wheel Drive (4WD)

4WD system improves traction and stability across rough terrain, mud, and uneven ground conditions.

Loader-Ready Design

Compatible with KIOTI front-end loaders for lifting dirt, gravel, hay, feed, pallets, and material handling tasks.

Independent PTO System

Independent PTO supports rotary cutters, finish mowers, tillers, snow equipment, and additional implements.

Category 1 Three-Point Hitch

Heavy-duty rear hitch supports a wide variety of agricultural and property maintenance attachments.

Deluxe Suspension Seat

Premium adjustable suspension seat improves operator comfort and reduces fatigue during extended work sessions.

Hydraulic Power Steering

Responsive hydrostatic steering system improves maneuverability and ease of operation.

LED Work Lighting

Integrated work lights improve visibility during early morning and late evening operation.

Easy Service Access

One-piece hood and centralized maintenance points simplify inspections and servicing.

General

  • Manufacturer: KIOTI
  • Model: NS4710HCB
  • Tractor Type: Compact Utility Tractor
  • Cab Type: Enclosed Cab with HVAC
  • Drive Type: 4WD

Engine

  • Engine Type: 3-Cylinder Turbo Diesel
  • Horsepower: 45 HP
  • Displacement: Approx. 1,826 cc
  • Fuel Type: Diesel
  • Cooling System: Liquid-Cooled
  • Fuel Capacity: Approx. 12.7 gal.

Transmission & Drivetrain

  • Transmission Type: Hydrostatic (HST)
  • Travel Ranges: 3-Range Infinite Speed
  • Steering: Hydrostatic Power Steering
  • Brakes: Wet Multi-Disc

PTO

  • PTO Type: Independent
  • Rear PTO Speed: 540 RPM
  • Mid PTO: Optional
  • PTO Horsepower: Approx. 35–37 HP

Hydraulics

  • Rear Lift Capacity: Approx. 2,700 lbs
  • Hitch Type: Category 1 Three-Point Hitch

Dimensions

  • Overall Length: Approx. 125 in.
  • Overall Width: Approx. 70 in.
  • Wheelbase: Approx. 71 in.
  • Ground Clearance: Approx. 14 in.

Weight

Additional Features

  • Tilt Steering Wheel
